result_text:
The "Undefined Team" remainder now only collects active unmatched contributors. I made a one-line change in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`, in `getAllTeams()` around line 735. The remainder condition now also requires `contributor.getContributor().isActive()`.

- **Dormant unmatched contributors** are skipped and do not appear in any team.
- **Configured teams** are untouched, so their members stay regardless of activity.
- **Blank latest-commit dates** count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank input.

The threshold is `Contributor.isActive()`, which uses the 180-day window. I did not add a test, since no existing test covers this class.

`mvn -q -o -pl codeanalyzer test -Dtest='*Contributor*'` ran with no output, which in quiet mode means it passed. I could not check the diff with git, because the tool was denied approval. Nothing is committed.
